name: unreal-connector
description: Lets Claude operate your open Unreal Editor: inspect the level, run Python, screenshot the viewport, play, save, and answer dialogs.
long_description: Pairs with the Claude Unreal Bridge plugin, which listens inside the Unreal Editor on 127.0.0.1. This extension forwards Claude's tool calls to it. Nothing leaves your computer except what Claude reads back through the tools.

tools.name: unreal_status
tools.description: Check the Unreal Editor is open and the bridge is listening

tools.name: get_level_info
tools.description: List the actors in the open level

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Run Python in the Unreal Editor

tools.name: save
tools.description: Save the level and changed assets

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Every bridge command, including project add-ons

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run any bridge command by name

tools.name: editor_windows
tools.description: See every Unreal window, dialogs included, even when the editor is frozen

tools.name: window_input
tools.description: Answer a dialog: click or press keys in an Unreal window

port.title: Unreal bridge port
port.description: The port the Claude Unreal Bridge listens on inside the editor (CLAUDE_UNREAL_PORT)
